title: Brown spoke of biblical UFOs and aliens with his family

tellings.quote: I also learned from Townsend Brown's daughter, Linda, that the inventor would constantly speak of biblical UFOs and aliens behind closed doors and with his family.

plain: The inventor Townsend Brown is said to have talked constantly, behind closed doors and with his family, about UFOs in the Bible and about aliens. Michels says he learned this from Brown's daughter, Linda Brown, and passes it on as hers. If so, the inventor held private views on the subject that he kept to his home.
